reviews.title: Broke but fixes
reviews.body: Caught a 3lb catfish and the fishing rod broke. I have used this fishing rod twice and this is unacceptable, However once I contacted the seller, they immediately sent out a replacement and any issues with replacement to contact them. They definitely made it right. Looking to purchase one for my wife. Thank you for making this right.

reviews.author: Bj Chavez

reviews.title: Perfect Compact fishing kit for motorcycle
reviews.body: Better late than never, this isn’t an item I purchased for myself , I got this for my husband who loves to fish and go on motorcycle rides. First off, he is an avid fisherman, and this is his go to fishing pole, it is so convenient that he can break it down and store it in the bag it comes with, with all of the lures, hooks he might need and the bag fits perfect inside his saddle bag, not only does he use it for his rides, he uses this pole everytime he fishes. He has mentioned to me that the reel is superior., the pole itself is good for traveling on his bike but Ofcourse he would like it to be bigger , overall, due to this purchase and other fishing accessory purchases, I’m hooked on fishing as well .I highly recommend this item. It’s a perfect Father’s Day gift or birthday gift.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 17, 2021
reviews.author: Cynthia Webster

reviews.title: Excellent compact unit.
reviews.body: The pole and reel are high quality. Was going to fly to Florida and had opportunity to fish once there with grandkids. We had it sent to family members driving…we were flying & short on time. Worked great - braided line was excellent. I now keep it in my car all the time to use whenever possible on vacations. It was small enough to fit in my suitcase on the return home.

features: Only one set of fishing gear is needed for fishing.Full Kit with Carrier Bag - 1 Fishing Rod + 1 Fishing Reel + Fishing Line + Various Fishing Lures + Fishing Hooks + Some Necessary Accessories + Carrier Bag.

Sougayilang telescopic fishing rod are constructed with High Density 24-Ton Carbon Fiber reinforced with Fiberglass Composite for power and elasticity ; The welded stainless steel guides with Zirconium Oxide rings for superior casting distance and accuracy while dissipating heat more efficiently which delivers excellent durability with monofilament, fluorocarbon and braided lines.

The Exquisite Fishing Reel Seat Is Made of Corrosion Resistant CNC Machined Aluminum for a solid base and all-day; EVA handles are comfortable, durable and exceptionally slip resistant giving you maximum control over your fishing rod in all conditions.
